description.value:
Duration while in combat

Your Ghost-Static pool has no maximum during combat — it resets to normal afterward. While it's active, there's no max left for Static Overflow to trigger off; that feat only matters again once combat ends and the cap comes back.

While you are in an encounter, your Static Cell has no capacity: you may hold any amount of Ghost-Static. When the encounter ends, your pool immediately drops to your normal capacity and the excess is lost with no effect. While this is in force, `Static Overflow` cannot trigger, because there is no maximum to exceed; it resumes working the moment the cap returns.
